title: THE TENTH CROISSANT
lesson: No thanks is a full sentence
caption: Can't say no to people? THE RULE BOOK Ep 17: Clyde ate nine croissants in Paris because the waiter asked nicely. Then Antoine found an old bill: two coffees, Le Prof and 'S'. Who is S? A) Solo B) Someone new. A or B? Comment CAST ME to join the story. #sayingno #liferules #meme #stickman

lines: I ATE NINE CROISSANTS. SEND HELP.

lines.tr: J'AI MANGÉ NEUF CROISSANTS. AU SECOURS.

lines: NO TH... OKAY, BET. YES PLEASE.

lines.tr: NON MER... BON, D'ACCORD. OUI MERCI.

lines: HE ASKED SO NICELY. I'M COOKED.

lines.tr: IL A DEMANDÉ SI GENTIMENT. JE SUIS FICHU.

lines: OLD BILL. TWO COFFEES: LE PROF AND S.

lines.tr: VIEILLE ADDITION. DEUX CAFÉS : LE PROF ET S.
CLYDE VIENT DE COMMANDER LE ONZIÈME CROISSANT.
